text:
julie_cs: heads up — Solaris (acct SOL-77) says invoice INV-2024-332 is missing their PO number after we applied a VAT adjustment. They need the invoice reissued with PO: PO-SOL-2211 or a credit+rebill. Can billing team advise? invoice id: INV-2024-332; charge_id: ch_0a1b2c3

samir_billing: looking now. pulled record — purchase_ref is blank on the final PDF. VAT adjustment workflow appears to have moved some metadata into invoice.notes (internal-only). :eyes:

billing-bot: Auto-check: invoice metadata -> status: paid, payment_method: card, payment_status: settled, tax_adjustment: +20.00 EUR, notes: "PO: PO-SOL-2211" (internal-only) — external PDF omitted private notes.

maria_escobar: Customer insists the PO must appear on the official invoice PDF for accounts payable. They cannot accept a credit note alone. Requesting reissue with PO visible.

eng_ops: quick repro — PDF renderer strips "notes" when tax_adjustment flag is present. Repro steps:
```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/invoice/render \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-2024-332","render_mode":"pdf"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
# output shows purchase_order not in pdf meta
```

samir_billing: suggested plan: because payment is already settled we should issue a credit memo, then create a new invoice that includes the corrected purchase_ref. Outline:
1) Create credit memo referencing INV-2024-332 (reason: PO missing) -> credit_memo id CM-778
2) Create new invoice with same line items + purchase_ref: PO-SOL-2211 -> INV-2024-333
3) Trigger rebill to original payment method (or manual invoice if finance prefers)
I can run this if approvals are OK.

julie_cs: Finance confirmed: rebill to the same card is OK for Solaris. Please tag action as "customer-approved" and run in prod.

samir_billing: running now. commands I will execute:
```
/admin/creditmemo create --invoice INV-2024-332 --reason "Add PO + VAT adjust" --force
/admin/invoice create --from-invoice INV-2024-332 --purchase_ref "PO-SOL-2211" --reissue
```
will post back IDs once complete.

billing-bot: Action started. credit_memo: CM-778 created at 2024-11-05T09:44:12Z. new_invoice: INV-2024-333 queued for payment.

julie_cs: thanks — i'll confirm with Solaris and close once they confirm receipt.

samir_billing: done — INV-2024-333 PDF now includes purchase_ref and PO field. Payment retried and settled. Marking for closure in 24h unless customer reports any discrepancy. :white_check_mark:

maria_escobar: Solaris confirmed they received the corrected invoice with PO on the PDF and accepted it. They waived the need for the original invoice. Marking resolved.

billing-bot: Thread closed by samir_billing.
